variety_description: Good yielding, late maturity, tall, medium slender variety suitable for cultivation under rainfed lowland conditions. Developed by BRRI from widely grown variety BR11 as a recipient parent. Released in 2010 for planting in north Bangladesh in Aman season. Seed distributed under the project STRASA. Submergence tolerance up to 15 days. Susceptible to major diseases and insect pests and drought conditions.
